sentences.en: The sun sank below the horizon and it got dark.
sentences.zh: 太阳沉到了地平线下，天黑了。

sentences.en: The sun sank below the horizon before I knew it.
sentences.zh: 我还没察觉到太阳就已经沉到了地平线下。

sentences.en: My horizons are broader than your pupils after cannabis consumption!
sentences.zh: 我的眼界比你吸大麻后的瞳孔还要开阔！

senses.zh: 地平线，视野；眼界，见识；（事物发展的）前景，可能性

mnemonic: 联想记忆：ho+riz（音似：rise升起）+ on →太阳从地平线上升起
